summary:
Reflected file download through ContentDisposition.Builder#filename(String, Charset):
the quoted-printable "filename" fallback (encodeQuotedPrintableFilename and its PRINTABLE
set) did not encode '"'. That fallback was added in 6.0.5 by commit 58fbf60d2d
("Include quoted printable filename in ContentDisposition::toString"); the GHSA range
starts at 6.0.5. In 5.3.20 ContentDisposition.toString writes only filename*= for a
non-ASCII charset, via encodeFilename, which percent-encodes every byte outside the
RFC 5987 attr-chars ('"' included). The fix f0e7b42704 changes a set 5.3.20 does not have.
